verses.greek: Καὶ παράγων εἶδεν ἄνθρωπον τυφλὸν ἐκ γενετῆς.
verses.literal: And passing by He saw a man blind from birth.
verses.dgt: As he was passing by, he saw a man blind from birth.

verses.greek: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες· Ῥαββί, τίς ἥμαρτεν, οὗτος ἢ οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἵνα τυφλὸς γεννηθῇ;
verses.literal: And asked Him the disciples of Him saying Rabbi who sinned this man or the parents of him that blind he may be born?
verses.dgt: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὔτε οὗτος ἥμαρτεν οὔτε οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ἵνα φανερωθῇ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus Neither this man sinned nor sinned the parents of him but it was that may be displayed the works the of God in him.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “Neither this man sinned nor his parents, but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

verses.greek: ἡμᾶς δεῖ ἐργάζεσθαι τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πέμψαντός με ἕως ἡμέρα ἐστίν· ἔρχεται νὺξ ὅτε οὐδεὶς δύναται ἐργάζεσθαι.
verses.literal: Us it behooves to work the works of the One who having sent Me while day it is is coming night when no one is able to work.
verses.dgt: We must work the works of the one who sent me while it is day. Night is coming, when no one can work.

verses.greek: ὅταν ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὦ, φῶς εἰμι τοῦ κόσμου.
verses.literal: While in the world I may be the light I am of the world.
verses.dgt: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα εἰπὼν ἔπτυσεν χαμαὶ καὶ ἐποίησεν πηλὸν ἐκ τοῦ πτύσματος, καὶ ἐπέχρισεν αὐτοῦ τὸν πηλὸν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς,
verses.literal: These things having said He spat on the ground and He made clay of the spittle and he rubbed on him the clay to the eyes
verses.dgt: After saying these things, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and spread the mud on the man’s eyes.

verses.greek: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ὕπαγε νίψαι εἰς τὴν κολυμβήθραν τοῦ Σιλωάμ (ὃ ἑρμηνεύεται Ἀπεσταλμένος). ἀπῆλθεν οὖν καὶ ἐνίψατο, καὶ ἦλθεν βλέπων.
verses.literal: And He said to him do go do wash yourself in the pool the of Siloam which means Sent. He went therefore and washed and came back seeing.
verses.dgt: Then he said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam,” which means “Sent.” So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

verses.greek: οἱ οὖν γείτονες καὶ οἱ θεωροῦντες αὐτὸν τὸ πρότερον ὅτι προσαίτης ἦν ἔλεγον· Οὐχ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ καθήμενος καὶ προσαιτῶν;
verses.literal: The therefore neighbours and those having seen him the before that a beggar he was were saying Surely this is the one sitting and begging?
verses.dgt: Then the neighbors and those who had seen him before as a beggar were saying, “Is this not the man who used to sit and beg?”

verses.greek: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν· ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ ὅμοιος αὐτῷ ἐστιν. ἐκεῖνος ἔλεγεν ὅτι Ἐγώ εἰμι.
verses.literal: Some were saying that He it is but others were saying No but like as him he is. He was saying that I myself am he.
verses.dgt: Some were saying, “It is he.” Others were saying, “No, but he is like him.” He kept saying, “I am he.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Πῶς ἠνεῴχθησάν σου οἱ ὀφθαλμοί;
verses.literal: They were saying therefore to him How were opened of you the eyes?
verses.dgt: So they were saying to him, “How then were your eyes opened?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ἐκεῖνος· Ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰησοῦς πηλὸν ἐποίησεν καὶ ἐπέχρισέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὅτι Ὕπαγε εἰς τὸν Σιλωὰμ καὶ νίψαι· ἀπελθὼν οὖν καὶ νιψάμενος ἀνέβλεψα.
verses.literal: Answered He The man who is being named Jesus clay made and He anointed my the eyes and He said to me that do go to the Siloam and do wash. yourself Having gone therefore and having washed I received sight.
verses.dgt: He answered, “The man called Jesus made mud, spread it on my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash.’ So I went, washed, and received my sight.”

verses.greek: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος; λέγει· Οὐκ οἶδα.
verses.literal: And they said to him Where is He? He says Not I know.
verses.dgt: They said to him, “Where is he?” He said, “I do not know.”

verses.greek: Ἄγουσιν αὐτὸν πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους τόν ποτε τυφλόν.
verses.literal: They bring him to the Pharisees who once was blind
verses.dgt: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had once been blind.

verses.greek: ἦν δὲ σάββατον ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ τὸν πηλὸν ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀνέῳξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.
verses.literal: Was now Sabbath in which day the clay made the Jesus and opened of him the eyes.
verses.dgt: Now it was a Sabbath on the day when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

verses.greek: πάλιν οὖν ἠρώτων αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πῶς ἀνέβλεψεν. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Πηλὸν ἐπέθηκέν μου ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς, καὶ ἐνιψάμην, καὶ βλέπω.
verses.literal: Again therefore were asking him also the Pharisees how he had received sight. the And he said to them Clay He put on my on the eyes and I washed and I see.
verses.dgt: So the Pharisees also asked him again how he had received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I see.”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων τινές· Οὐκ ἔστιν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ὅτι τὸ σάββατον οὐ τηρεῖ. ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλὸς τοιαῦτα σημεῖα ποιεῖν; καὶ σχίσμα ἦν ἐν αὐτοῖς.
verses.literal: Were saying therefore of the Pharisees some Not is this from God the man for the Sabbath not He does keep. Others were saying How is able a man sinful such signs to do? And division there was among them.
verses.dgt: Then some of the Pharisees were saying, “This man is not from God, because he does not keep the Sabbath.” But others were saying, “How can a sinful man do such signs?” And there was a division among them.

verses.greek: λέγουσιν οὖν τῷ τυφλῷ πάλιν· Τί σὺ λέγεις περὶ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς; ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ὅτι Προφήτης ἐστίν.
verses.literal: They say therefore to the blind man again What you yourself say concerning Him for He opened of you the eyes? the And he said that A prophet He is.
verses.dgt: So they said again to the blind man, “What do you say about him, since he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

verses.greek: Οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἦν τυφλὸς καὶ ἀνέβλεψεν, ἕως ὅτου ἐφώνησαν τοὺς γονεῖς αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀναβλέψαντος
verses.literal: Not did believe then the Jews concerning him that he was being blind and received sight until when they called the parents of him who having received sight
verses.dgt: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they called the parents of the man who had received his sight.

verses.greek: καὶ ἠρώτησαν αὐτοὺς λέγοντες· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμῶν, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη; πῶς οὖν βλέπει ἄρτι;
verses.literal: And they asked them saying This is the son of you of whom you yourselves say that blind he was born? How then does he see presently
verses.dgt: They asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπαν· Οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ὅτι τυφλὸς ἐγεννήθη·
verses.literal: Answered therefore the parents of him and said We know that this is the son of us and that blind he was born
verses.dgt: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son and that he was born blind.

verses.greek: πῶς δὲ νῦν βλέπει οὐκ οἴδαμεν, ἢ τίς ἤνοιξεν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἡμεῖς οὐκ οἴδαμεν· αὐτὸν ἐρωτήσατε, ἡλικίαν ἔχει, αὐτὸς περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λαλήσει.
verses.literal: How however presently he sees not we know or who opened of him the eyes we ourselves not know him do ask of age is He himself Concerning himself he will speak.
verses.dgt: But how he now sees, we do not know, or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him; he is of age. He will speak for himself.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα εἶπαν οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐφοβοῦντο τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, ἤδη γὰρ συνετέθειντο οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα ἐάν τις αὐτὸν ὁμολογήσῃ χριστόν, ἀποσυνάγωγος γένηται.
verses.literal: These things said the parents of Him because they were afraid of the Jews already for had agreed together the Jews that if anyone Him shall confess Christ expelled from the synagogue he shall be.
verses.dgt: His parents said these things because they were afraid of the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if anyone confessed him as Christ, that person would be put out of the synagogue.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτο οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ εἶπαν ὅτι Ἡλικίαν ἔχει, αὐτὸν ἐπερωτήσατε.
verses.literal: Because of this the parents of him said that Age he has him do question.
verses.dgt: For this reason his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”

verses.greek: Ἐφώνησαν οὖν τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐκ δευτέρου ὃς ἦν τυφλὸς καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Δὸς δόξαν τῷ θεῷ· ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν.
verses.literal: They called therefore the man out a second time who were blind and they said to him do give glory the to God! We ourselves know that this the man a sinner is.
verses.dgt: So for a second time they called the man who had been blind and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη οὖν ἐκεῖνος· Εἰ ἁμαρτωλός ἐστιν οὐκ οἶδα· ἓν οἶδα ὅτι τυφλὸς ὢν ἄρτι βλέπω.
verses.literal: Answered then he Whether a sinner He is not I know One thing I do know that blind being now I see.
verses.dgt: He answered, “Whether he is a sinner, I do not know. One thing I know: though I was blind, now I see.”

verses.greek: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ· Τί ἐποίησέν σοι; πῶς ἤνοιξέν σου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς;
verses.literal: They said therefore to him What did He to you? How opened He of you the eyes?
verses.dgt: Then they said to him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν ἤδη καὶ οὐκ ἠκούσατε· τί πάλιν θέλετε ἀκούειν; μὴ καὶ ὑμεῖς θέλετε αὐτοῦ μαθηταὶ γενέσθαι;
verses.literal: He answered them I told you already and not you did listen. Why again do you wish to hear? Surely not also you yourselves do wish His disciples to become?
verses.dgt: He answered them, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You do not also want to become his disciples, do you?”

verses.greek: ἐλοιδόρησαν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπον· Σὺ μαθητὴς εἶ ἐκείνου, ἡμεῖς δὲ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἐσμὲν μαθηταί·
verses.literal: railed at him and said You yourself a disciple are of that One we ourselves however the of Moses are disciples.
verses.dgt: Then they insulted him and said, “You are that man’s disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

verses.greek: ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν ὅτι Μωϋσεῖ λελάληκεν ὁ θεός, τοῦτον δὲ οὐκ οἴδαμεν πόθεν ἐστίν.
verses.literal: We ourselves know that to Moses has spoken the God this man however not we know from where is.
verses.dgt: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where he is from.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐν τούτῳ γὰρ τὸ θαυμαστόν ἐστιν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἐστίν, καὶ ἤνοιξέν μου τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς.
verses.literal: Answered the man and said to them In this for the an amazing thing is that you yourselves not know from where He is and yet He opened my the eyes.
verses.dgt: The man answered them, “Now this is an amazing thing: you do not know where he is from, and yet he opened my eyes.

verses.greek: οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἁμαρτωλῶν ὁ θεὸς οὐκ ἀκούει, ἀλλʼ ἐάν τις θεοσεβὴς ᾖ καὶ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιῇ τούτου ἀκούει.
verses.literal: We know that to sinners the God not does listen but if anyone God-fearing shall be and the will of Him shall do to him He listens.
verses.dgt: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if anyone is God-fearing and does his will, he listens to that person.

verses.greek: ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἠκούσθη ὅτι ἠνέῳξέν τις ὀφθαλμοὺς τυφλοῦ γεγεννημένου·
verses.literal: Out of the age never it has been heard that opened anyone the eyes of one blind born.
verses.dgt: From ancient times it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of one born blind.

verses.greek: εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος παρὰ θεοῦ, οὐκ ἠδύνατο ποιεῖν οὐδέν.
verses.literal: only unless were this man from God not He was able to do no thing.
verses.dgt: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἐν ἁμαρτίαις σὺ ἐγεννήθης ὅλος, καὶ σὺ διδάσκεις ἡμᾶς; καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω.
verses.literal: They answered and they said to him In sins you yourself were born entirely and you yourself teach us? And they cast him out.
verses.dgt: They answered him, “You were born entirely in sins, and you are teaching us?” And they threw him out.

verses.greek: Ἤκουσεν Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω, καὶ εὑρὼν αὐτὸν εἶπεν· Σὺ πιστεύεις εἰς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου;
verses.literal: Heard Jesus that they had cast him out and having found him He said You yourself believe in the Son the of Man?
verses.dgt: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and after finding him he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν· Καὶ τίς ἐστιν, κύριε, ἵνα πιστεύσω εἰς αὐτόν;
verses.literal: Answered he and said And who is He lord that I may believe in Him?
verses.dgt: He answered, “And who is he, sir, so that I may believe in him?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Καὶ ἑώρακας αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετὰ σοῦ ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Said to him the Jesus Both You have seen Him and the One speaking with you He is.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and he is the one speaking with you.”

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ ἔφη· Πιστεύω, κύριε· καὶ προσεκύνησεν αὐτῷ.
verses.literal: the And he was saying I believe Lord And he worshiped Him.
verses.dgt: He said, “I believe, Lord,” and he worshiped him.

verses.greek: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰς κρίμα ἐγὼ εἰς τὸν κόσμον τοῦτον ἦλθον, ἵνα οἱ μὴ βλέποντες βλέπωσιν καὶ οἱ βλέποντες τυφλοὶ γένωνται.
verses.literal: And said the Jesus For judgment I myself into the world this came that those not seeing may see and those seeing blind may become.
verses.dgt: Then Jesus said, “For judgment I came into this world, so that those who do not see may see and those who see may become blind.”

verses.greek: ἤκουσαν ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ταῦτα οἱ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὄντες, καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ ἡμεῖς τυφλοί ἐσμεν;
verses.literal: Heard from the Pharisees these things who with Him being and they said to Him Surely not also we ourselves blind are?
verses.dgt: Some of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things and said to him, “We are not blind too, are we?”

verses.greek: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ τυφλοὶ ἦτε, οὐκ ἂν εἴχετε ἁμαρτίαν· νῦν δὲ λέγετε ὅτι Βλέπομεν· ἡ ἁμαρτία ὑμῶν μένει.
verses.literal: Said to them the Jesus If blind you were not then would you have sin. since however you say that We see the sin of you remains.
verses.dgt: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would not have sin. But now that you say, ‘We see,’ your sin remains.”
